source_note: Torque specification taken from the Big Blue Book's prose (page 349), replacing a family of visual estimates for crankset fasteners.

nodes.name: Crank bolt torque
nodes.description: Tightening torque for the bolt or nut that holds a crank arm to the bottom bracket spindle: 25 to 38 Nm (300 to 450 inch-pounds) depending on brand.

evidence.section: FIGURE 7.11: Remove crank from spindle by turning driver of
evidence.quote:
The bolt/nut may need 25 to 38 Nm (300 to 450 inch-pounds)
depending upon brand.

edges.claim: The crank arm's fixing bolt is tightened to 25-38 Nm, brand dependent.
conditions: Torque varies by brand: 25 to 38 Nm
